snippet.title: Jet Set Gertie - RZX Playback
snippet.description:
Jet Set Gertie
1985 - Spectrum Computing (UK),Spectrum Computing 17
ZX-Spectrum 48K - Arcade Game: Platform

Recorded by Pavel Plíva (with rollback)

More info here: https://spectrumcomputing.co.uk/entry/2588/ZX-Spectrum/Jet_Set_Gertie

We are most grateful to the late Daren Pearcy for all his work in popularising the RZX format. Without his work this project would not have been possible.
